area: My Work queue and coordinator triage dialogs (web/src/features/myWork/MyWorkPage.tsx, TriageWorkItem.tsx, incidents/IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx, eventGroups/EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx, eventGroups/EventGroupTriageMap.tsx; delegated UI verified in assessments/AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx, ui/ModalDialog.tsx, ui/AppShell.tsx). Inventory verified against code; corrections: (1) changing the radius does NOT always force CREATE_NEW or the associated group — when the new radius returns a non-empty list that lacks the current selection, the stale selectedId is kept (ghost selection, see issues); (2) after any assessment action the queue reloads with no success notice (notice is only set on triage, MyWorkPage.tsx:177) — a bigger gap than the inventory recorded; (3) 'Loading assessment…' / 'Loading Event Group context…' persist after a failed fetch; (4) the shared 'Optional workflow notes' textarea is also sent with Add reviewer and cleared after every action. Claims about LoginPage, RoleRoute and SubmissionDetailPrimitives were not re-read and are excluded.

heuristicIssues.screen: Assessment work item panel / My Work queue
heuristicIssues.issue: Delegate, Assign engineer, Submit for review, Request revision, Approve and Finalize give no confirmation; the item leaves the queue and the detail column silently jumps to the first remaining item, so a first-day chief cannot tell whether the click worked or which assessment is now on screen.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:208-220 (run() has no success message), MyWorkPage.tsx:88 (selection falls back to items[0]), :99-104 (onChanged=refresh), :177 vs :181 (notice is set only by onTriaged, never by AssessmentDetailPanel's onChanged)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Make onChanged accept a message ('Assessment #7 delegated to J. Smith') and render it in the existing green notice banner with a Dismiss button; keep the next item selected but announce the change (role=status).

heuristicIssues.issue: Irreversible workflow transitions fire on a single 28px button with no confirmation and no required reason; 'Request revision' silently substitutes the note 'Revision requested.' when the textarea is empty, so the engineer receives a revision with no rationale.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:306 (Delegate), :315 (Assign), :319 (Submit), :323 (reviewAssessment(..., notes.trim() || "Revision requested.")), :324 (Approve), :328 (Finalize); button size :126-128
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Route Approve/Finalize/Delegate through the existing ModalDialog as a one-line confirm that names the target ('Delegate Assessment #7 to Branch Chief J. Smith?'); disable Request revision until notes is non-empty and label the textarea 'Reason for revision (required)'.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: A failed 'Record triage decision' reports through onError to the page-level red banner that sits behind the z-50 black/55 overlay while the dialog stays open, so the coordinator sees the button return to normal and nothing else; on a phone the banner is entirely off-screen.
heuristicIssues.evidence: TriageWorkItem.tsx:43-44 (catch -> onError), :37 (setDialog(null) only on success); IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:27-55 (DialogShell has no error slot), MyWorkPage.tsx:127 (banner at top of page), ModalDialog.tsx:25 (overlay)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add an optional error prop to DialogShell rendered above the fields, mirroring the in-dialog banner already used in EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:174; keep the page banner only for queue-load failures.

heuristicIssues.screen: My Work queue / Event Group review dialog
heuristicIssues.issue: When the follow-up fetch fails, the UI shows a red error AND a permanent 'Loading…' placeholder with no retry: getAssessment failure leaves detail null so 'Loading assessment…' stays forever; a failed event-group-context load leaves context null so 'Loading Event Group context…' stays and the radius control (the only reload trigger) is unreachable.
heuristicIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:93-95 (catch sets error, detail stays null), :180-183 (renders 'Loading assessment…' whenever detail is null); EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:100-101, :176 (!context -> loading text), :181 (radius select only rendered inside the context branch)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Track a failed state per fetch and render 'Couldn't load assessment #7 — Retry' in place of the loading text; in the dialog, show the error with a Retry button and keep Cancel enabled.

heuristicIssues.issue: Ghost selection after a radius change: load() keeps the current selectedId whenever the new list is non-empty, even if that group is no longer listed. No row is highlighted, the map still previews the unlisted group's incidents, and 'Record decision · use selected Event Group' remains enabled and will POST the invisible group id.
heuristicIssues.evidence: EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:92-94 (setSelectedId(current => current ?? nearby.items[0].id)), :113-120 (incident preview fetch keyed on selectedId), :122-125 (selected resolves to null), :191 (no active row), :208 (disabled only when !selectedId)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: After load, reconcile: setSelectedId(current => items.some(g => g.id === current) ? current : null) and require an explicit choice; also add the selected group's title to the Record button label so the target is always visible.

heuristicIssues.issue: The nearest open Event Group (up to 25 miles away by default) is pre-selected as the decision whenever any group is in range, so the path of least resistance is 'Record decision' -> associate; 'Starts its own event' must be actively chosen. Mis-association is persisted immediately (see next issue).
heuristicIssues.evidence: EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:69 (default 25 mi), :92-94 (auto-select items[0]), :208-209 (one-click Record)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Start with no radio checked and the Record button disabled until the coordinator picks; sort/emphasise distance and show a warning chip when the nearest group is > 5 mi away.

heuristicIssues.issue: The association is written to the server the moment Record is pressed, before any disposition; Cancel/Esc afterwards leaves the incident linked with no undo, and reopening triage shows 'Decision recorded' with Continue already enabled, so the step reads as done even if it was a slip.
heuristicIssues.evidence: EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:140-146 (POST then reload), :155 (decisionSaved from server), :211, :237; IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:68-79 (step state lives only in the dialog)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Hold the choice client-side and submit it with the disposition in one request, or add a 'Change decision' control that shows the current association and re-enables the list, and confirm before overwriting an existing association.

heuristicIssues.issue: A mousedown on the 16px overlay margin closes the dialog and discards the typed decision notes and chosen disposition with no confirmation; on a phone the margin is exactly where a thumb rests.
heuristicIssues.evidence: ModalDialog.tsx:25 (overlay p-4), :108-110 (backdrop mousedown -> onClose); TriageWorkItem.tsx:83 (onClose -> setDialog(null) drops state); IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:100 (notes live in state)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add a closeOnBackdrop prop defaulting to false for multi-step dialogs, or prompt 'Discard notes?' when state.notes is non-empty.

heuristicIssues.issue: One flat list mixes field-report triage with five assessment states, with no grouping, filter, search or per-kind counts; triage items are sorted newest-first so the oldest waiting report sinks to the bottom; the queue never auto-refreshes and shows no 'updated at', so a coordinator working a shared queue acts on stale items.
heuristicIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:52-61 (up to 7 lists, limit 1000), :71 (sort newest first within kind), :123 (single count), :99-104, :124 (manual Refresh only), :139-170 (flat map)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add group headers with counts ('Field reports to triage (3)', 'Assessments (5)'), a kind/state filter chip row, oldest-first ordering for triage, and refetch on window focus plus a 'Updated 2 min ago' stamp next to Refresh.

heuristicIssues.screen: My Work queue / Triage panel / Triage dialogs
heuristicIssues.issue: One pre-intake state has three labels ('New report' pill, 'Awaiting triage' pill, 'Field report #N — not yet in the incident record' eyebrow); step 2 mixes 'Disposition', 'Decision notes' and 'Record triage decision'; its description says the key is minted 'when the coordinator approves and forwards the Incident' although no approve/forward control exists; step 1 has a separate 'Coordinator note' so two note fields exist in one flow.
heuristicIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:153; TriageWorkItem.tsx:55, :59; IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:85, :93, :99, :106; EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:207
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use 'Awaiting triage' everywhere; rename the field to 'Triage decision' and the button to 'Record decision'; rewrite the description to match the actual control; merge the two note fields or label them 'Note on Event Group choice' vs 'Triage note'.

heuristicIssues.issue: The coordinator must decide a disposition from title, description, location and time only; reporter, contact, incident type and photos require leaving the queue via 'Open incident record', and the step-1 dialog repeats none of the report facts, so the decision is made from memory.
heuristicIssues.evidence: TriageWorkItem.tsx:52-65 (fields shown), :63 (escape hatch); EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:165-171 (header shows only incident id)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Fetch /incidents/:id in TriageWorkItem and show reporter, type, photo count and a thumbnail strip; repeat a one-line report summary in the dialog header.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.screen: Rail cards / Assessment panel / Event Group dialog / Map
heuristicIssues.issue: Raw codes reach the user: 'Office NORTH · D7' in the rail while the panel says 'North GeoTech Office · District 7'; reporter shown as 'User #14'; 6-decimal coordinates inline; every Event Group row and popup leads with '#12 ·'; header shows role enums.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:434 vs :59-62, :234; :354 ('User #'); TriageWorkItem.tsx:57 (formatCoordinate); EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:195; EventGroupTriageMap.tsx:103, :115; AppShell.tsx:157
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Reuse officeLabel() in AssessmentRailCard; return reporter names in the submission index; move coordinates behind a 'Copy coordinates' action; drop the '#id ·' prefix from rows (keep it in a tooltip).

heuristicIssues.screen: My Work queue / Triage panel / Triage dialogs
heuristicIssues.issue: Repeated and constant chrome: the queue count appears twice 15px apart; every triage card carries the same 'New report' pill; three onboarding paragraphs (triage panel, step-1 description, step-2 three-sentence policy text) reappear on every single triage.
heuristicIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:123 and :138; :153; TriageWorkItem.tsx:72; EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:168; IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:85
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Remove the rail header count and the constant pill; collapse the explanations into a single 'How triage works' disclosure remembered in localStorage.

heuristicIssues.issue: Hidden coupling: the single 'Optional workflow notes' textarea in the Next-step card is also submitted with 'Add reviewer' in the Assignments card, and run() clears it after every action, so notes drafted for Delegate vanish when the chief adds a reviewer first.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:294 (shared textarea), :212 (setNotes('') after every run), :374 (addAssignment ... notes: notes.trim()), :383 (Remove also goes through run)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Scope notes to the workflow action only (do not pass or clear them on assignment changes), and move reviewer management into the Next-step card for chiefs.

heuristicIssues.issue: Disabled controls give no reason: when the server returns can_change_association=false the radios stay interactive but Record is silently disabled; Continue is disabled with only a muted 'Record the decision to continue' line; Delegate/Assign are disabled until a select is chosen with no hint.
heuristicIssues.evidence: EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:132, :186-196 (radios never disabled), :208 (disabled expression), :211, :237; AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:306, :315
heuristicIssues.recommendation: When !can_change_association, disable the radios and show 'Event Group is locked for this incident'; use aria-describedby helper text explaining each disabled state.

heuristicIssues.issue: busy=true during the initial context/nearby fetch blocks Esc, x and backdrop close; if the API stalls the coordinator is trapped in a dialog that only says 'Loading Event Group context…'.
heuristicIssues.evidence: EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:79-80 (setBusy(true) in load), :161-162 (busy passed to ModalDialog), :170 (x disabled), :236; ModalDialog.tsx:62-68, :109
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Split loading from saving; pass only saving as busy so Cancel/Esc always work while loading.

heuristicIssues.screen: My Work queue / Assessment work item panel
heuristicIssues.issue: The active rail card is conveyed by border colour only (no aria-current/aria-pressed) and the rail is a div grid, not a list; error/notice/loading messages are not live regions; the three routing selects and the notes textarea have no programmatic label; the map container has aria-label on a role-less div.
heuristicIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:127-128, :132, :139-149, :183; AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:294, :298-305, :311-314, :370-373, :447-449; EventGroupTriageMap.tsx:129
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add aria-current='true' to the active card, role='list'/'listitem' wrappers, role='status' on notice/loading and role='alert' on errors, visible labels (or aria-label) on selects/textarea, role='region' on the map div.

heuristicIssues.issue: Selection is never written to the URL (clicking a card clears search params), so a queue item cannot be bookmarked or shared and F5 loses it; the ?assessment deep link silently falls back to the first item when the id is not in the queue.
heuristicIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:85 (only sets when present), :88 (fallback to items[0]), :148, :166 (setSearchParams({}))
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Write ?item=t12 / ?item=a7 on select and restore it on load; when a deep-linked id is absent show 'Assessment #7 is no longer waiting on you' with a link to /assessments/7.

heuristicIssues.issue: First paint shows 'Nothing needs your attention' because loading is initialised false and only becomes true inside the effect; the empty state also doubles as the loading state, so the two are visually identical.
heuristicIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:40 (useState(false)), :80 (load in effect), :130-134 (same box for both)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Initialise loading=true (or track loaded) and render a skeleton of 3 rail cards while loading.

heuristicIssues.issue: Two dialog header implementations in one flow (DialogShell: text-lg title, p-5 panel, max-w-xl; hand-built header: text-base title, px-5 py-4, max-w-6xl) and ad hoc button classes per file (text-sm py-2 vs text-xs py-1.5 vs an outlined-brand variant).
heuristicIssues.evidence: IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:27-55 vs EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:163-171; TriageWorkItem.tsx:63, :76; AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:126-128; EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:208
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Give DialogShell a size prop and reuse it for step 1; adopt one Button component with primary/secondary/danger/success variants.

heuristicIssues.issue: Every marker click opens an undocked popup whose last line says 'Click the marker to select this Event Group.' after the click has already selected it; popups clutter a 380px map.
heuristicIssues.evidence: EventGroupTriageMap.tsx:54 (dockEnabled:false), :55-64 (click selects), :103 (popup text)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Remove the instruction line; show a hover/tap tooltip with title + distance instead of a full popup for group markers.

heuristicIssues.issue: 'All GISA forms attached to this assessment's incident' introduces 'GISA form' vocabulary that the rest of the panel calls 'technical submission'; select options append the email to every name, lengthening the dropdown.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:336, :339 vs :288, :291; :300, :304, :313
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use one term ('technical submission (GISA form)' once in the card title); show the email only in the option's title attribute.

heuristicIssues.issue: Non-selected assessment cards show a generic 'Waiting on <role>' because assignments are only known for the selected item, so the rail cannot tell a chief which engineer each item is waiting on.
heuristicIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:163 (assignments passed only when detail matches), AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:428 (waitingOn(assessment, assignments ?? []))
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Include the current assignee summary in the list payload (or prefetch assignments for the visible cards) so the card shows the name.

responsiveIssues.issue: Rail and detail stack (two columns only at xl); the rail may grow to 860px, the auto-selected item's panel sits below the fold and tapping a card does not scroll to it, so a first-day user sees a list, taps, and nothing visible happens.
responsiveIssues.fix: Below xl switch to master/detail: when an item is selected render only the detail with a '← Queue (N)' button (or scrollIntoView the detail section on select); cap the rail at max-h-[40vh] on <xl.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 1024x768 the lg sidebar (w-64) appears but the two-column grid still needs xl (1280), leaving ~700px of single-column content beside a 256px nav; at 768 portrait the inline nav card plus single column pushes the queue ~250px down.
responsiveIssues.evidence: AppShell.tsx:164-165 (lg:hidden inline nav; w-64 sidebar at lg), MyWorkPage.tsx:136 (xl breakpoint)
responsiveIssues.fix: Use lg:grid-cols-[minmax(280px,0.6fr)_minmax(0,1.4fr)] for the queue and default the sidebar to collapsed (w-16) below xl; replace the inline nav card with a drawer.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 1440x900 the rail is not sticky and is capped at a hard 860px while the detail panel (4 cards + table + history) often exceeds 1500px, so scrolling to history or assignments loses the queue entirely.
responsiveIssues.evidence: MyWorkPage.tsx:136 (items-start), :137 (max-h-[860px], no sticky); AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:228-406 (four stacked cards)
responsiveIssues.fix: xl:sticky xl:top-[calc(var(--header-h)+16px)] on the rail with max-h-[calc(100vh-180px)] instead of 860px.

responsiveIssues.issue: The six-step pipeline needs about 500px (6 x min-w-[74px] plus connectors) but roughly 280px is available inside the card, so it scrolls horizontally with no cue; the 7-column submissions table also scrolls and its Action column is off-screen by default.
responsiveIssues.fix: Below sm render the pipeline as a compact 'Step 3 of 6 · Engineering' line with an expandable vertical stepper; below md render submissions as stacked cards (descriptor, status badge, Open button) and hide ID/Reporter columns until lg.

responsiveIssues.issue: Office chief action row: two flex-1 selects share one ~280px row so 'Assign engineer now (optional)…' is truncated, Delegate wraps to a third line; all action buttons are text-xs py-1.5 (~28px) and the reviewer select is py-1 — below 44px touch targets.
responsiveIssues.fix: Give selects basis-full sm:basis-auto; apply min-h-11 and text-sm to buttons/selects under @media (pointer: coarse).

responsiveIssues.issue: At 375x812 the 92vh panel holds a 52vh scroll box for the list, then the form, Record button and status, then a fixed 380px map and summary — three nested scroll contexts (locked body, dialog body, list); the map is ~700px down and, once reached, ArcGIS captures touch pan so swiping over it no longer scrolls the dialog.
responsiveIssues.evidence: EventGroupAssociationDialog.tsx:163 (max-h-[92vh]), :173 (overflow-y-auto body), :185 (max-h-[52vh] overflow-auto), :221 (height={380}); EventGroupTriageMap.tsx:54 (MapView), :129 (fixed height); ModalDialog.tsx:47 (body overflow hidden)
responsiveIssues.fix: Below lg render a segmented 'List | Map' switch in the dialog header; drop the list max-h on <lg; size the map with min(380px, 45vh); make the panel full-screen (h-dvh rounded-none) under sm; on coarse pointers set view.navigation.browserTouchPanEnabled=false with a 'Use two fingers' hint or require the Map tab to be active.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768x1024 the lg grid is inactive so the list (52vh = 532px) stacks above the 380px map inside a 736px-wide panel that could hold both; at 1024x768 the two columns engage but 92vh (707px) minus header/footer leaves ~560px for a 380px map plus summary, so the summary scrolls.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use md:grid-cols-[minmax(260px,0.9fr)_minmax(0,1.2fr)] and derive the map height from the column (aspect-[4/3] max-h-[50vh]) instead of a fixed prop.

responsiveIssues.issue: Undocked popups open inside a 343x380 map and get clipped; group markers are 13-18px and incident markers 9-12px — hard to hit with a finger; no loading indicator while the MapView initialises.
responsiveIssues.fix: Dock popups to bottom-center on <md (dockOptions.breakpoint) or disable popups on touch; bump symbol sizes to >= 20px when matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)') matches; render a skeleton until view.when() resolves.

responsiveIssues.issue: The footer is flex justify-between with no wrap: 'Review Event Group again', 'Cancel' and 'Record triage decision' need ~450px in a ~303px panel, so each button shrinks and wraps its label onto 2-3 lines.
responsiveIssues.evidence: IncidentDecisionDialogs.tsx:102-107 (no flex-wrap); ModalDialog.tsx:25-26 (p-4 overlay, max-w-xl p-5 panel)
responsiveIssues.fix: Use flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-between; make buttons w-full sm:w-auto with the primary rendered first in DOM order so it lands at the bottom on phones.

responsiveIssues.issue: Location + 6-decimal lat/long + 'Reported <date time>' run as one 13px line that wraps into three lines; the 'Awaiting triage' pill wraps under the title.
responsiveIssues.fix: Split into two lines (location / reported) and move coordinates into a 'Copy coordinates' button; place the pill before the title on <sm.

responsiveIssues.issue: Mobile navigation is an always-open inline card of every nav link above the content, costing ~250px of the first screen on every page.
responsiveIssues.fix: Replace with a hamburger-triggered drawer using ModalDialog's focus trap, keeping the page title and queue count in the first viewport.

responsiveIssues.issue: Active rail card is conveyed only by a brand border/tint and non-active cards rely on a hover border — on touch devices there is no hover, and on low-contrast themes the active state can vanish.
responsiveIssues.fix: Add a 3px left accent bar plus aria-current on the active card and a chevron/‘Selected’ affordance that does not depend on hover.

dataDensity.element: 'N items waiting on your role' count (MyWorkPage.tsx:123)
dataDensity.reason: Queue size is the first thing every role checks; split into per-kind counts.

dataDensity.element: Rail header 'N items waiting on you' (MyWorkPage.tsx:138)
dataDensity.reason: Exact duplicate of the count directly above it.
Only way to see new items; add 'updated X ago' and auto-refresh so it becomes secondary.
Only surface for queue-load failures; add Dismiss and make it a live region.
Confirms the outcome after the item disappears; extend to assessment actions and add Dismiss.
Handle and subject are the minimum needed to pick the next item.
Constant on every triage card; the 'Triage ·' prefix and a group header already convey the kind.
Where and how old drive triage priority; render age ('2 h ago') rather than a full timestamp.
Incident id is useful; office/district codes matter only to chiefs spanning offices — show humanized and only when the user's queue spans more than one office.
Tells the user which step the item is on — the card's key signal.
Explains why the item is in my queue; needs the assignee name for chiefs.
Relevant to engineers/reviewers at DRAFT/SUBMITTED; noise at delegation/assignment steps — show only for those states.
Enum strings help nobody; show one humanized primary role and hide the rest in the account menu.
Global chrome that steals the first viewport on phones; move to a drawer.

dataDensity.reason: Frames why intake is needed; shorten to 'Field report #N · Awaiting triage' and drop the separate pill.
Core facts for the disposition.
Sub-metre precision is noise; the step-1 map already plots the point — expose via 'Copy coordinates'.
Third label for the same state on one screen.
The reporter's narrative is the primary evidence for the disposition.
The viewer is that coordinator; keep the card, drop the redundant 'Waiting on' line.
Onboarding text repeated on every item; collapse into a 'How triage works' disclosure.

dataDensity.element: Reporter / incident type / photos (not shown today)
dataDensity.reason: Missing essentials: the disposition cannot be judged without them; add to the panel.

dataDensity.element: Header: Assessment #, incident title, office · district · updated (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:232-234)
dataDensity.reason: Identity and routing context; humanized already.
Progress at a glance; collapse to a one-line stepper on phones.
This is the primary task; move it above the header links if anything.
Needed for revision/delegation rationale; label it and make it required for Request revision.
Duplicated by the descriptor link and the Action link in the same row.
A raw id adds nothing; show a name or drop the column below lg.
Audit detail; keep Submitted, hide Created behind the row/expand.
Reviewers need to know which row to open.

dataDensity.reason: Names are useful context but management belongs with the chief's Next-step actions; emails can be tooltips.
Audit trail rarely needed to act; collapse by default showing the last event only.
Orientation for a two-step flow; shorten the description.
Scope control that directly changes the candidate list.
The alternative decision; make it visually equal to the group rows.
Title, location and distance already distinguish rows.

dataDensity.reason: Distance and location are the decision signal; put distance first and bold.
Already shown only when 'Starts its own event' is chosen; keep that behaviour.
Optional and duplicated by step-2 notes; show behind 'Add a note' or merge.

dataDensity.reason: Repeats the row; only the open-incident count and description are new — show them in the selected row instead.
Spatial fit is the point of the step; give it viewport-relative height.
Only key to the three symbol types.
Selection already highlights the row; replace group popups with a short tooltip, keep incident popups.
No layer list widget exists; never visible.
Useful once; move into a 'What happens next' disclosure and fix the copy.
Redundant immediately after step 1; replace with a one-line 'Event Group: <title> (change)' summary.
The decision and its consequence; consider radio cards so all four consequences are visible at once.
Timeline rationale; make required for 'Needs reporter information' and 'Duplicate or linked'.
Not rendered by any listed file; delete or wire into the incident record.
